sentences.text: Code vs In Re: Sanjib Bhandari on 9 July, 2024

Author: Soumen Sen
Bench: Soumen Sen
09.07.2024
Court No.29
Item No. 48
Allowed
 sg
 Crm (A) 2261 of 2024
 In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of the Code
 Criminal Procedure in connection with Serenga Police Station Case No. 72 o
 2023 dated 17.10.2023 under Sections 498A/323/420/506/34 of the Indian Pen
 Code, pending before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kha
 And
 In Re: Sanjib Bhandari
 Petitioner
 Mr. Saswata Gopal Mukherji
 Ms. Debadrita Mondal
 Ms. Sudeshna Chanda
 For the Petitioner
 Md. Aammar Zati
 Ms. Ankita Pal
 For the State
 1.
Claiming parity with the co-accused person, namely, Sabita Bhandari, a prayer for anticipatory bail is made.

2. The learned Counsel for the State has not denied that the present petitioner is standing on the same footing as that of the co-accused person namely, Sabita Bhandari, who have been granted anticipatory bail on 28th February, 2024 in CRM(A) 697 of 2024.

3. Keeping in view that the petitioner is standing on the same footing as that of the co-accused person, we extend the same benefit to the petitioner also and we allow the prayer for anticipatory bail of the present petitioner.

Code vs In Re: Sanjib Bhandari on 9 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/68425374/
1 4.

Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest the petitioners namely, Sanjib Bhandari, shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/-, with two sureties of like amount each, to the satisfaction of Arresting Officer and also be subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
The petitioner will cooperate with the investigation till the conclusion of the investigation.

The petitioner shall appear on every date before the Jurisdictional Court on and from the date fixed for appearance of the accused and in default the Jurisdictional Court will pass appropriate order to secure the presence of the petitioner in court including cancelling the anticipatory bail granted without further reference to this Court.
5. Accordingly, the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner is allowed.
6. CRM (A) 2261 of 2024 is, thus, disposed of.
7. All parties shall act on the server copies of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.

(Soumen Sen, J.) (Uday Kumar, J.)
